rules.coverage_conditions: Residential rental property in the City of San Diego
rules.exemptions: Reports from public or 90-day-old aggregated data that do not recommend future rents; affordable-housing program rent or income limit tools; appraisal software that does not recommend rents
rules.interaction: Local ban; no state-level ban in this document.
rules.title: San Diego ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices (Division 11)
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use, and no one may sell or license to a landlord, software that uses nonpublic competitor data of two or more landlords to recommend rents or occupancy levels. A tenant can sue for injunction, damages or civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation; each month and each property is a separate violation.
rules.key_value: ban on algorithmic devices using nonpublic competitor data; up to $1,000 per violation
rules.quoted_span: (b) It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property.

notes: Enacted codified text (added 5-22-2025 by O-21955 N.S., effective 6-21-2025), so in_force. Header lists manifest id D074; if D074 is supplied corpus text, the consolidator should prefer its quoted span.
